designation_timing: User-authorized promotion after completed scaling, twelve-target and test2 comparisons

ipin_tuna_31k_ensemble.architecture_origin: Published Bernett TUnA; iPIN TRAIN-only PU adaptation
ipin_tuna_31k_ensemble.inference_mode: Set gp_layer.fitted=True BEFORE eval; inference mode; no dropout, AMP or TF32; SDPA enabled
ipin_tuna_31k_ensemble.input_pipeline: Full-context ESM-2 layer-30 residue representations; full-length native TUnA endpoints; symmetric elementwise maximum; 4096 random Fourier features
ipin_tuna_31k_ensemble.precision: FP32 model, attention, residues and GP buffers; FP64 member-score mean; no AMP/TF32
ipin_tuna_31k_ensemble.selection_rule: three-seed mean scores; common epoch per budget; maximize 0.5*C3 reconciled-legacy concordance + 0.5*C3 added concordance
ipin_tuna_31k_ensemble.selection_tie_break: smaller positive budget, then earlier epoch; strict numeric ordering without a tolerance

tuna_retrained_ensemble.architecture_origin: Published Bernett TUnA; iPIN TRAIN-only PU adaptation
tuna_retrained_ensemble.input_pipeline: Full-context ESM-2 layer-30 residue representations; full-length native TUnA endpoints; symmetric elementwise maximum; 4096 random Fourier features

tuna_retrained_ensemble.selection_rule: Maximum C3-development concordance of the FP64 mean of three adjusted-logit members; exact ties choose earlier epoch; no seed acceptance gate
